Metadata.description: Modern apps, websites and digital services.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.body: The page has moved or no longer exists.

cta.title: Interested?
cta.text: Write to us, and we will get back to you with a no-obligation quote.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: The page could not be loaded. The problem is on our side, so please try again shortly.

login.title: Log in
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts in a short time. Wait a few minutes and try again.
login.unavailable: Logging in is not working right now. Please try again shortly.
login.linkInvalid: The link is invalid or has expired. Request a new link to reset your password, or ask the owner for a new invitation.

forgotPassword.title: Reset password
forgotPassword.lead: Enter your email, and we will send you a link where you can choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: Check your email. If the address belongs to an account with access, we have sent a link to choose a new password.

setPassword.title: Choose a new password
setPassword.lead: Choose the password you want to log in with from now on.
setPassword.samePassword: The new password must be different from your current one.
setPassword.weakPassword: The password is too easy to guess. Choose a longer password.
setPassword.reauthenticationNeeded: For security reasons, you need a new link to change your password. Log out and request a reset link on the login page.
setPassword.failed: The password could not be saved. Please try again shortly.

noAccess.title: No access
noAccess.help: Contact the owner if you think this is a mistake, or log out and log in with a different account.
noAccess.switchAccount: Log in with a different account

validation.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least {min} characters long.
validation.passwordTooLong: The password is too long. It can be at most {max} characters, and fewer if it contains æ, ø, å or similar characters.
validation.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.

landing.metaTitle: Get notified when a web page changes
landing.title: Get notified when a web page changes
landing.lead: Add the pages you want to keep an eye on. We check them automatically and email you when the content changes. Free for up to {limit} pages.

add.title: Add a URL
add.body: Paste the address of the page you want to monitor, and choose how often we should check it (hours or days).

watch.title: We keep watch
watch.body: We fetch the page on your schedule and compare its text with the last check.

mail.title: You get an email
mail.body: When the page changes, you get an email showing what changed, with a link to the page.

landing.note: It's free for now. More pages will be available later on a paid plan.

login.lead: Log in to see your monitors.
login.linkInvalid: The link is invalid or has expired. Sign up again with the same email to get a new confirmation link, or request a new link to reset your password.

signup.title: Create account
signup.lead: Monitor your first pages for free.
signup.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. We will send you a confirmation email before you can log in.
signup.privacyNote: We use your email to log you in and to notify you about changes.
signup.confirmationBody: If {email} can be used for a new account, we have sent a link that confirms the address. Follow the link to log in. If you already have an account, you can log in or reset your password.
signup.rateLimitedCopy: Too many attempts in a short time. Wait a few minutes and try again.
signup.unavailableCopy: Signing up is not working right now. Please try again shortly.

forgotPassword.sent: If the address belongs to an account, we have sent a link where you can choose a new password.

noAccess.body: The account {email} does not have access to Monitor.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The monitor or page does not exist, or it belongs to another account.

dashboard.title: Your monitors
dashboard.lead: We check the pages and email you when something changes.
dashboard.limitReached: You have used all your monitors. Delete one before you add a new one.
dashboard.emptyTitle: Add the first page you want to keep an eye on
dashboard.emptyBody: Paste the address, and we will check the page and email you when it changes.

add.title: Add monitor
add.lead: We check the page on your schedule and email you when its content changes.

edit.title: Edit monitor
edit.lead: If you change the address, we will compare against the new page from now on.

form.urlHint: Public pages only. Internal and local addresses are rejected automatically.
form.label: Name (optional)
form.limitReached: You have reached the limit for how many pages you can monitor. Delete a monitor before you add a new one.

errors.urlRequired: Enter the address of the page.
errors.urlInvalid: Enter a valid address, e.g. https://example.com/page.
errors.urlScheme: The address must start with http:// or https://.
errors.urlCredentials: The address must not contain a username or password.
errors.urlPort: Use an address without a port number (or with port 80 or 443).
errors.urlBlockedHost: We can only monitor public pages. Internal and local addresses are rejected.
errors.urlTooLong: The address is too long. It can be at most {urlMax} characters.
errors.labelTooLong: The name can be at most {labelMax} characters.
errors.intervalInvalid: Choose a whole number of hours or days.

detail.deleteBody: {name} and its change history will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
detail.noChangesBody: When the page changes, you can see it here, and you will get an email.

settings.title: Settings
settings.notificationsNote: Change alerts go to the email you log in with.
settings.passwordLead: Choose the password you want to log in with from now on.

MonitorEmail.signupNoticeBody: {email} created an account on Alnyron Monitor and confirmed their email {when}.
MonitorEmail.signupNoticeWaiting: {waiting, plural, one {# other is also waiting for a notice.} other {# others are also waiting for a notice.}}
MonitorEmail.signupNoticeFooter: You get this email because you own Alnyron. We only write about new accounts that have confirmed their email, and at most once per account.
